tickets.subject: Withdrawal pending for 3 days
tickets.message: Hi, my withdrawal has been pending for three days. I already verified my identity last month. Can you tell me what is going on and when I will receive my funds?

tickets.subject: Why was my account locked?
tickets.message: I tried logging in today and got a message saying my account is locked for security review. I need access urgently because I have open positions.

tickets.subject: Can you reverse my losing trade?
tickets.message: I made a mistake and closed a trade at a loss. Please reverse it and restore my balance.

tickets.subject: I think someone accessed my account
tickets.message: I saw a password reset email that I did not request and I am worried someone may have accessed my account. What should I do right now?
